text:
{
  "outcome": "translated",
  "clause_id": "l171_426_n016",
  "abstain_reason": null,
  "claims": [
    "C1 an instruction is misaligned if it conflicts with the letter of a higher-level instruction",
    "C2 an instruction is misaligned if it conflicts with the implied intent behind a higher-level instruction",
    "C3 a Model Spec principle with user authority is overridden by an explicit developer or user instruction, and is therefore misaligned",
    "C4 a Model Spec principle with guideline authority is overridden by an explicit or implicit developer or user instruction, and is therefore misaligned"
  ],
  "acts": [],
  "concepts": [
    { "name": "misaligned_instruction", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "I is an instruction that conflicts with the letter or implied intent of some higher-level instruction",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l171_426_n016", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "root_authority", "arity": 0,
      "gloss": "the root authority level, the highest in the authority hierarchy, assigned to Model Spec 'root' sections",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l171_426_n016", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "authority_levels_hierarchy", "arity": 2,
      "gloss": "the ranking of instruction authority levels: root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority, used to determine which instruction prevails in conflicts",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l171_426_n016", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "applicable_instruction", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "I is an instruction that applies to the current request, determined by filtering candidate instructions",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l171_426_n016", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "higher_level_instruction", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "I is an instruction whose authority level is higher than the authority level of the instruction being judged",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the clause speaks of 'some higher-level instruction'; comparing authority levels requires a relation between the instruction and a higher one",
      "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "conflicts_with_letter", "arity": 2,
      "gloss": "instruction I conflicts with the letter of instruction J",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the clause defines misalignment by conflict with the letter or implied intent; these are two distinct conflict relations",
      "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "conflicts_with_intent", "arity": 2,
      "gloss": "instruction I conflicts with the implied intent behind instruction J",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the clause defines misalignment by conflict with the letter or implied intent; these are two distinct conflict relations",
      "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "model_spec_principle", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "P is a principle stated in the Model Spec",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the example speaks of Model Spec principles; the class is needed to state the example",
      "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "has_authority", "arity": 2,
      "gloss": "instruction I carries authority level A",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the example assigns user or guideline authority to principles; each instruction must carry an authority level",
      "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "explicit_instruction", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "I is an instruction stated outright in a message of this conversation",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the example distinguishes explicit from implicit instructions; the distinction is a fact about the case",
      "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "implicit_instruction", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "I is an instruction conveyed by a message of this conversation without being stated outright",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the example distinguishes explicit from implicit instructions; the distinction is a fact about the case",
      "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "developer_instruction", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "I is an instruction issued by a developer",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the example names developer instructions as a source of override",
      "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "user_instruction", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "I is an instruction issued by a user",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the example names user instructions as a source of override",
      "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "overridden_by", "arity": 2,
      "gloss": "instruction I is overridden by instruction J, meaning J prevails over I in a conflict",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the example says principles 'can be overridden by' instructions; override is the relation that makes the principle misaligned",
      "toggleable": false }
  ],
  "ontology": [
    { "licence": "textual", "cites": "l171_426_n016", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "atom": "misaligned_instruction(I)",
      "gloss": "I is misaligned because it conflicts with the letter of a higher-level instruction",
      "body": "conflicts_with_letter(I, J), higher_level_instruction(J)" },
    { "licence": "textual", "cites": "l171_426_n016", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "atom": "misaligned_instruction(I)",
      "gloss": "I is misaligned because it conflicts with the implied intent behind a higher-level instruction",
      "body": "conflicts_with_intent(I, J), higher_level_instruction(J)" },
    { "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the example states that a principle with user authority overridden by an explicit developer or user instruction is misaligned; this is the example's instance of the general definition",
      "toggleable": false,
      "atom": "misaligned_instruction(P)",
      "gloss": "P is misaligned because it is a Model Spec principle with user authority overridden by an explicit developer or user instruction",
      "body": "model_spec_principle(P), has_authority(P, user), overridden_by(P, J), explicit_instruction(J), (developer_instruction(J); user_instruction(J))" },
    { "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the example states that a principle with guideline authority overridden by an explicit or implicit developer or user instruction is misaligned; this is the example's instance of the general definition",
      "toggleable": false,
      "atom": "misaligned_instruction(P)",
      "gloss": "P is misaligned because it is a Model Spec principle with guideline authority overridden by an explicit or implicit developer or user instruction",
      "body": "model_spec_principle(P), has_authority(P, guideline), overridden_by(P, J), (explicit_instruction(J); implicit_instruction(J)), (developer_instruction(J); user_instruction(J))" }
  ],
  "asserts": [],
  "beats": [],
  "defines": [],
  "closure": [],
  "requires": ["root_authority/0", "authority_levels_hierarchy/2", "applicable_instruction/1"],
  "inputs": ["conflicts_with_letter/2", "conflicts_with_intent/2", "higher_level_instruction/1", "model_spec_principle/1", "has_authority/2", "explicit_instruction/1", "implicit_instruction/1", "developer_instruction/1", "user_instruction/1", "overridden_by/2"],
  "forbid_body": []
}
